title: Split a PDF Into Separate Pages — No Install Needed
description: How to split PDF files into individual pages using FileTools — free, private, and instant in your browser.
excerpt: One click per page. Every page saved separately. No apps, no uploads to shady servers.
content:
You have a 30-page PDF. You need page 7, 12, and 24 as separate files. The rest can wait.

Most PDF editors make this painful. Adobe wants a subscription. Free tools upload your document somewhere. Neither is acceptable.

## Split in seconds

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) does it differently. Drag your PDF onto the page, select which pages you want, and download them individually or as a batch ZIP. All in your browser.

No account. No install. No file size limit that matters.

## Your files never leave

Everything runs client-side with WebAssembly. The PDF never touches a server. Close the tab, and every trace is gone.

This is the right way to handle documents with sensitive data — contracts, invoices, medical records. [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) treats your privacy like it matters, because it should.

## More than splitting

Extracted a page? You can merge it into another PDF, convert it to Word, or compress it for email. [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) does all of that without switching tools.

Even [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io) follows a similar philosophy — upload a photo, get a redesigned room. No bloat, just results.

## The bottom line

Splitting a PDF should be trivial. With [FileTools](https://filetools.eu), it is. Free, fast, and your data stays yours.
